name: Ayman Elslamony
subDescription: Mobile Platform & CI/CD Automation | White-Label SDK
aboutDescription:
Senior Flutter Engineer with 4+ years of production experience, specializing in mobile platform architecture and release automation.

What makes my profile different:

→ Built a multi-tenant White-Label SDK — one Flutter codebase serving multiple enterprise clients, each with their own branding, backend, and store listing. Zero code duplication.

→ Published a native iOS/Android Flutter Plugin on Pub.dev (HyperPay payment bridge via Platform Channels) — proving deep understanding of Flutter's native interop layer.

→ Architected a full CI/CD release pipeline (Azure DevOps + GitHub Actions + Fastlane + Firebase Distribution) — cut release cycles by 15%.

→ Built an internal API Inspector tool giving QA and backend teams real-time API visibility — eliminated false escalations between teams.

→ Delivered 18+ production applications across e-commerce, healthcare, and logistics.

Open to: Remote opportunities | Gulf relocation | Europe relocation

experiences.job: Senior Flutter Engineer — Mobile Platform & CI/CD
experiences.description:
- Designed and shipped a multi-tenant White-Label SDK: one Flutter codebase serving multiple enterprise clients with per-client branding, backend, and store listing — eliminated duplicate codebases.
- Built an internal API Inspector tool for real-time API debugging, reducing false escalations between mobile and backend teams.
- Architected full CI/CD pipeline: Azure DevOps + GitHub Actions + Fastlane + Firebase Distribution with SDK caching — release cycles ↓ 15%.
- Led coding standards initiative and code reviews — post-release bugs ↓ 30%.
- Mentored 2 junior developers.

- Refactored a legacy codebase using Clean Architecture, significantly improving maintainability.
- Engineered and delivered a key geo-fenced student attendance feature.
- Successfully delivered 2 production-ready iOS applications under a tight deadline.

- Developed and launched over 8 of the company's 11+ mobile applications.
- Translated complex Figma prototypes into pixel-perfect, responsive, and high-performance UIs.
- Collaborated with backend teams to design and integrate critical RESTful APIs.

- Managed end-to-end development for 6+ client apps with 95% on-time delivery.
- Architected apps from scratch using modern state management (Bloc/Provider).
